_comment: The launch catalogue. Single authoring source: the app reads it as a fallback until the database holds blueprint_packages, and db/gen-seed.mjs turns it into db/002_homeowner_seed.sql. Prices are cents. Levers: price = base + sum of the chosen option deltas.
